title: Detailed Phone Lab redesign verified
summary: Replaced plain internal blocks with detailed component assemblies and refined the Phone Lab layout for smaller screens.

changes.detail: Layered battery pouch with seams and markings; PCB traces, contacts, processor shield, inset memory chips, camera housings, sensor optics, speaker grille, USB recess and chassis screws.
Compact mobile canvas, graphite studio background, quieter selection treatment, rectangular controls, organized full-width topic rows and refined lesson typography.
Large all-caps battery/speaker block labels and excessive selection outlines across component polygons.
Selection uses one component outline rather than outlining individual battery markings and details.

validation.name: Interaction and history tests
validation.detail: 10 tests passed: Phone Lab in English/French/Arabic and six history tests. Four Phone Lab tests passed again after the selection outline refinement.

validation.name: Typecheck and lint
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck and focused ESLint passed, including after final renderer refinement.

validation.name: Model visual inspection
validation.detail: Generated and inspected the open-phone canvas replay at artifacts/phone-cover-inside.png. Components, traces, markings and selection border are visible. This is a model-only PNG render, not a screenshot of the live app. Font cache warnings did not prevent output.

validation.name: History retention
validation.detail: History check passed with 189 reports before this linked follow-up; all previous reports retained.

validation.name: Browser and physical device
validation.detail: Browser verification was attempted, but the browser tool reported no available browsers. Responsive CSS has not been visually checked in a live browser or native WebView. No deployment or APK rebuild.
